title: CipherSight: Robust Website Fingerprinting via Record-Resource Semantic Supervision under Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2608.13905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: HTTPS website fingerprinting (WF) aims to identify visited websites from metadata observable in encrypted traffic. However, real-world deployments introduce a significant out-of-distribution (OOD) problem caused by temporal and geographic changes, while previously unseen websites are common in open-world scenarios. Existing methods primarily learn from raw TCP packet sequences and struggle to capture stable and generalizable website representations, resulting in performance degradation under practical conditions.   We propose CipherSight, a TLS-record-based hierarchical framework for robust HTTPS WF. Unlike existing approaches that rely on TCP packet sequences and are sensitive to transport-layer artifacts, CipherSight learns website representations from TLS records by jointly encoding multiple record-level attributes. It introduces a hierarchical architecture that captures both intra-flow dependencies among TLS records and inter-flow

translated_title: CipherSight：通过记录-资源语义监督在分布偏移下实现鲁棒的网站指纹识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13905v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：HTTPS网站指纹识别（WF）旨在从加密流量中可观测的元数据识别访问的网站。然而，实际部署中，由时间和地理变化引起的显著分布外（OOD）问题，以及开放世界场景中常见的前所未见的网站，给现有方法带来了挑战。现有方法主要从原始TCP数据包序列中学习，难以捕获稳定且可泛化的网站表示，导致在实际条件下性能下降。我们提出CipherSight，一种基于TLS记录的分层框架，用于鲁棒的HTTPS WF。与依赖TCP数据包序列且对传输层伪影敏感的方法不同，CipherSight通过联合编码多个记录级属性，从TLS记录中学习网站表示。它引入了一种分层架构，捕获TLS记录之间的流内依赖关系以及流间交互。
tldr: CipherSight通过基于TLS记录的分层框架，利用记录-资源语义监督，有效解决了分布偏移下的网站指纹识别鲁棒性问题。
en_tdlr: CipherSight addresses robust website fingerprinting under distribution shifts via a TLS-record-based hierarchical framework with record-resource semantic supervision.
